findings.issue: Tokenizer artifact: the reading きごう (記号 = 'symbol', the POS label for the whitespace tokens) leaked into the phonetic transcription twice. Learners would read a nonexistent word.
findings.current: えきえのきごういきかたがきごうわかりません
findings.suggested: えきえのいきかたがわかりません

findings.issue: Same tokenizer artifact: きごう (記号, POS label of the space tokens) inserted twice into the phonetic transcription.
findings.current: せんせいからきごうほんをきごうもらいました
findings.suggested: せんせいからほんをもらいました

findings.issue: 一本 is read いっぽん (geminate sokuon), never いちぽん. Wrong counter reading taught to learners.
findings.current: すぷーんがいちぽんたりない
findings.suggested: すぷーんがいっぽんたりない

findings.issue: Numeral 一 before counter 本 assimilates to いっ (一本 = いっぽん); reading いち is wrong in this context.
Distinct from the known punctuation/katakana romaji issue: the spurious reading 'kigou' (from the whitespace tokens) appears twice in the romanization.
Spurious 'kigou' (reading assigned to the whitespace tokens) appears twice in the romanization; not covered by the known punctuation/katakana issue.
Romanization reflects the wrong kana reading of 一本: 'ichipon' should be 'ippon'.
Whitespace token (surface " ") carries the reading きごう — the tokenizer's 記号 POS label was stored as a reading. It should have no reading.
Second whitespace token also carries the spurious reading きごう; should be empty.
Whitespace token (surface " ") carries the spurious reading きごう (記号 POS label); should be empty.
Second whitespace token also carries the spurious reading きごう; should be empty.
何も is read なにも in standard Japanese; なんも is a colloquial/dialectal contraction and should not be the taught reading, even in a casual sentence.
findings.current: あさからなんもたべていない
findings.suggested: あさからなにもたべていない

findings.issue: Token 何 in 何も should read なに (standard なにも), not なん.
都市 is glossed as 'big city, metropolis'; it simply means 'city / urban area' (metropolis would be 大都市). Overstated definition in a teaching explanation.
findings.current: 都市 ('big city, metropolis') + 化する = 都市化する ('to urbanize')
findings.suggested: 都市 ('city') + 化する = 都市化する ('to urbanize')

findings.issue: Mesmo problema da versão em inglês: 都市 significa 'cidade', não 'cidade grande, metrópole' (isso seria 大都市).
findings.current: 都市 ('cidade grande, metrópole') + 化する = 都市化する ('urbanizar-se')
findings.suggested: 都市 ('cidade') + 化する = 都市化する ('urbanizar-se')

findings.issue: Token 時計 is glossed 'clock' but the sentence translation renders it 'watch' (この時計 = this watch); the gloss should match the in-context sense.
Role label 'dono do さ' is confusing/garbled — the mountain 'owns' the height (高さ), not the bare suffix さ. Awkward phrasing a reviewer would reword.
